description: This file defines a class SecureZodSchemaParser that safely parses Zod schema strings into Zod schema objects, handling nested structures and modifiers while preventing arbitrary code execution.

classes.name: SecureZodSchemaParser
classes.description: A class providing static methods to securely parse Zod schema strings into Zod schema objects, supporting nested schemas and modifiers.

methods.name: parseZodSchema
methods.description: Main method to parse a Zod schema string into a Zod schema object, handling errors.

methods.name: cleanSchemaString
methods.description: Removes comments and normalizes whitespace in the schema string.

methods.name: parseSchemaStructure
methods.description: Extracts the structure of the schema, ensuring it starts with 'z.object('.

methods.name: parseObjectProperties
methods.description: Parses properties within an object schema string.

methods.name: splitProperties
methods.description: Splits object properties by commas, respecting nested structures.

methods.name: parseProperty
methods.description: Parses a single property into key and value, converting the value into a schema representation.

methods.name: parseZodType
methods.description: Parses a string representing a Zod type, including nested objects, arrays, and chained modifiers.

methods.name: parseArray
methods.description: Parses array types, including arrays of objects and simple types.

methods.name: validateTypeInfo
methods.description: Validates that the parsed type information uses only allowed types and modifiers.

methods.name: parseArguments
methods.description: Parses arguments within parentheses for modifiers and type parameters.

methods.name: parseArrayContent
methods.description: Parses comma-separated items within array content.

methods.name: extractArrayWithModifiers
methods.description: Extracts array part and modifiers from a type string.

methods.name: extractObjectWithModifiers
methods.description: Extracts object part and modifiers from a type string, handling nested structures.

methods.name: parseComplexArguments
methods.description: Parses complex arguments, including object literals for default values.

methods.name: parseObjectLiteral
methods.description: Parses object literals used as default values in modifiers.

methods.name: buildZodSchema
methods.description: Constructs a Zod object schema from parsed property types.

methods.name: buildZodType
methods.description: Builds a Zod type from parsed type information, handling nested schemas and modifiers.

methods.name: applyModifiers
methods.description: Applies modifiers such as max, min, optional, default, etc., to a Zod type.
